{{CharInfobox |color={{black color light}} |corecolor={{ruby color light}} |bordercolor={{black color dark}} |name=Katie |jname=カエデ |tmname=Kaede |slogan=no |image=Katie Hoenn.png |size=250px |caption=Katie |gender=Female |hometown=[[Lilycove City]] |region=[[Hoenn]] |trainer=yes |trainerclass={{pkmn|Trainer}} |game=no |leader=no |team=no |brain=no |anime=yes |epnum=AG128 |epname=Shocks and Bonds |enva=[[Andi Whaley]] |java=[[Yōko Sōmi]] }} '''Katie''' (Japanese: '''カエデ''' ''Kaede'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] from [[Lilycove City]] whom {{Ash}} battled during the [[Ever Grande Conference]]. ==History== [[File:Katie and Ash.png|220px|left|thumb|Katie and Ash]] ===''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]''=== Katie debuted in ''[[AG128|Shocks and Bonds]]'', where she was one of 32 Trainers who made it through the first round of the [[Ever Grande Conference]]. During the competition, she gained enormous respect among the participants. During her battle with Ash, she took out two of Ash's Pokémon without having any of hers faint. Ash finally was able to take out her {{p|Dugtrio}} with his {{AP|Glalie}}. However, the {{type|Ice}} was soon defeated by her {{p|Misdreavus}}'s {{m|Destiny Bond}}. [[File:Hoenn Rivals.png|250px|thumb|Katie in ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'']] In ''[[AG129|A Judgment Brawl]]'', however, Ash was able to turn the battle in his favor using his three remaining Pokémon. His {{AP|Corphish}} took out her {{p|Golduck}}, and from there, he eventually defeated Katie and moved on in the Victory Tournament. After the battle, she congratulated Ash and wished him good luck in the tournament. ===''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''=== In ''[[JN118|Battling as Hard as Stone!]]'', Katie was seen watching {{an|Steven Stone|Steven}}'s [[Masters Eight Tournament]] match against Ash on [[television]]. {{-}} ==Character== Katie is the pride of [[Lilycove City]], where her fashion and flair have given her the title "Cool Beauty". Her hobbies include playing the clarinet and her favorite food is spicy spaghetti with [[Tamato Berry|Tamato Berries]]. In battle, she most commonly uses {{p|Venomoth}} and {{p|Golduck}} and is known for carefully analyzing her opponent's moves. Katie's battle style was different from many other Trainers in {{aniseries|PTS}}. Instead of sticking with one Pokémon in battle until it fainted, she would switch out her Pokémon for a stronger one if hers had a disadvantage. It was due to this strategy that she nearly defeated {{Ash}} in the first part of their battle. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} This listing is of Katie's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Katie |pkmn=Venomoth |type1=Bug |type2=Poison |img=Katie Venomoth.png |epnum=AG128 |epname=Shocks and Bonds |vajp=Chinami Nishimura |vaen=Eric Stuart |desc={{p|Venomoth}} was the first Pokémon used in the [[Full Battle]] against {{Ash}} in ''[[AG128|Shocks and Bonds]]''. After dodging a {{m|Flamethrower}} from [[Ash's Torkoal]], it was [[recall]]ed. It was seen again in [[AG129|the next episode]] where it battled [[Ash's Corphish]] and then [[Ash's Swellow]]. After a fierce flying battle, it was defeated by the {{type|Flying}} Pokémon's {{m|Quick Attack}}. Venomoth's known moves are {{m|Stun Spore}}, {{m|Disable}}, and {{m|Supersonic}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Katie |pkmn=Golduck |type1=Water |img=Katie Golduck.png |epnum=AG128 |epname=Shocks and Bonds |desc=Katie's {{p|Golduck}} was seen in the battle against Ash. Golduck's known moves are {{m|Hydro Pump}}, {{m|Fury Swipes}}, and {{m|Confusion}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Katie |pkmn=Dugtrio |type1=Ground |img=Katie Dugtrio.png |epnum=AG128 |epname=Shocks and Bonds |vaen=Eric Stuart |desc=Katie sent out {{p|Dugtrio}} against [[Ash's Pikachu]] and thanks to the type advantage, it defeated the {{type|Electric}} Pokémon easily. Walrein has also used {{m|Quick Attack}}{{tt|*|Ash's Grovyle's}} via Mimic.}} ==Achievements== ===Badges obtained=== This listing is of the [[Badge]]s Katie has obtained in the [[Hoenn]] [[region]]: * At least eight Badges (prior to ''[[AG126|Saved by the Beldum]]'') ===Pokémon League=== Katie has competed in the following [[Pokémon League Conference]]s: * [[Ever Grande Conference]] - Top 32 (''[[AG129|A Judgment Brawl]]'') ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{ruby color light}}|bordercolor={{black color light}} |ja=沢海陽子 ''[[Yōko Sōmi]]'' |en=[[Andi Whaley]] |fi=Annituuli Kasurinen |fr_eu=Julie Basecqz |pt_br=Letícia Quinto |es_eu=Felicidad Barrio |es_la=Lizzette Sotorriba}} ==Trivia== * Her design is based on the female {{tc|Ace Trainer|Cooltrainers}} from [[Generation III]]. She favors [[Flavor|spicy]] food, which is the flavor of [[Pokéblock]] and [[Poffin]] that raises the [[Cool (condition)|Cool]] condition of a Pokémon. * She shares her title with {{tc|Cool Beauty|the Trainer class of the same name}} in [[Pokémon Battle Revolution]]. * Katie is the first female Trainer Ash faced in a [[Full Battle]] during a Pokémon League. ==Related articles== {{Leaguetrainers|ruby}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Animation characters]] [[de:Kathie]] [[es:Katie]] [[fr:Katie]] [[it:Katie (Hoenn)]] [[ja:カエデ (アニメ)]] [[zh:小楓（水靜市）]]
